test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight girls, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting around a circular table and facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). A is sitting second to the left of B. F is sitting to the immediate left of C. D is not an immediate neighbour of either F or E. H is not an immediate neighbour of B. Only three girls are sitting between A and D.

Who among the following girls are the immediate neighbours of D?
solution:
The given arrangement is as follows:

There are Eight girls, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting around a circular table and facing the center.

1) A is sitting second to the left of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa83628cfb110dab41ac8bbb17c2a3691014eacafd53ac3b5173959e8b84207.png] 

2) Only three girls are sitting between A and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71931ae02c5ea6338a46b9a89a258e17c9d9297af9322dd8aa715c2674f28034.png] 

3) F is sitting to the immediate left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f3506f649dcc05c17f687fefc0030853f5a727195bb309d982bb3cf11d694ff.png] 

4) D is not an immediate neighbour of either F or E. H is not an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7f832ab86a56d6ab6562f76e4abbfd4cace66f308d75b460617efaa2bcc2b61.png] 

So, the final arrangement is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/317109a9a848ea2261471de7657c7903735630bb7178c7571aa3bd7385cbc87a.png] 

The immediate neighbours of D are **H and G.**

Hence, the correct answer is** " H ****and G ".**
